sayLines.line: Ingrid is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
Grace came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.

◈ FLASHBACK — Reading Glasses
You read the fine print on medicine bottles for Titilayo next door, because their hands shook. Dosages, warnings, the tiny words that matter. The apocalypse has fine print too.
